articles.title: Angels squander more strong pitching in loss to Pirates
articles.description: Ryan Johnson continues his hot stretch with six strong innings, but the Angels have no answers for La Mirada High product Jared Jones (six scoreless innings) in a 1-0 defeat in Pittsburgh.

articles.title: Mike Trout’s home run drought ends but Angels lose to Nationals
articles.description: Trout’s 21st homer of the season – just his third since the All-Star break – ends a homerless stretch of 27 games, but the Angels give up three runs in the eighth and lose, 4-3.

articles.title: Alexander: This is a good day for Angels fans
articles.description: The announcement of Stan Kroenke’s purchase of a controlling interest from Arte Moreno should be cause for celebration for a long-suffering but stubbornly loyal fan base.

articles.title: Angels fans rejoice online and in person after learning of team’s sale
articles.description: From crying tears of joy to proclaiming Tuesday, Sept. 1, as the best day of their lives, many Angels supporters were ecstatic about the news.

articles.title: Stan Kroenke delivers hope, brings leverage Arte Moreno couldn’t with Angels
articles.description: Commentary: While the team’s new owner could prosper in Anaheim, he has moved a franchise before with great success.

articles.title: Anaheim, community leaders optimistic at news of Angels sale
articles.description: The sale could be something of a fresh start in negotiations over the stadium’s future, which haven’t gone anywhere since the City Council canceled the sale in 2022 amid a corruption scandal.

articles.title: Angels’ Kurt Suzuki says 2019 Nationals stressed patience, belief, trust
articles.description: The first-year manager was a catcher for Washington’s World Series championship team, and he says the lessons learned with that group have proven useful as he leads the Angels.
